profile.name: 文件管理器
profile.description: 这是实验软件中的文件管理界面，用于浏览、打开、删除和定位实验相关的文件与文件夹，例如采集数据、图像结果或脚本目录。它不是独立的实验硬件设备，而是实验控制系统中的文件操作组件。
profile.description_en: This is a file management interface within laboratory software, used to browse, open, delete, and locate experiment-related files and folders such as acquired data, image outputs, or script directories. It is not a standalone piece of lab hardware, but a file-operation component in the lab control system.

registry.name: Files Controller
registry.description: Files Controller是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括打开。支持Signal, Slot, browse等操作。
